question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What do you think about Kimi?
Are you going to get the second Surviving High School novel, `How to Be a Star`?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now, Kimi, come with me! You're going to hang out backstage.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whee! Okay! Great! Lily, come on!

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're doing an act with your sister?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ha ha. Technically in this case, Lily's the talent. She's playing the piano for my song!
They duck under the curtain and walk backstage. They pass by Sam on their way to the dressing room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, curtain in five. Oh, Kimi, hi. You're here!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yep! $ZOE said I could sing! Thank you both `so` much for letting me do this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yep! $ZOE said I could sing! Thank you both [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much for letting me do this!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I brought my costume with me. I'm going to change into it right now! Where is the bathroom?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Down the hall. After you change, you'll be hanging out in the dressing room. You're going to be the last act.
Kimi and Lily walk away, and Sam grabs $ZOE's arm.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I get why Kimi wants to do this. But it's going to be hard enough running a perfect show as it is. And you want to put an extra performer in?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, but I couldn't say 'no'. This is her chance.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, okay. We'll... Get it all straightened out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, we will.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Controversial? My daughter?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, the video she did made many people happy, but it also made other people... Not happy.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: I am always telling her that she does have an attitude, and she's always getting into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Mom,` she doesn't mean it like that... Does she?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mom,[/i][/color] she doesn't mean it like that... Does she?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! It's not that Kimi's in trouble. It's that her video was so popular that people might vote for her and skew the results of the Talent Show!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, if Kimi's going up, we need to go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I knew that if she competed, there was a chance that the audience would vote for her solely on her popularity.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Is that so? I always knew my Kimi could split votes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I trust the student body to make the right decision. If they think Kimi's the best, she's the best!
Kimi mouths the word 'thank you' behind her mother.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, she's so... Controversial?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me. There's some fat-free popcorn at concessions that has my name on it!
Missy brushes past $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So much pressure! I don't know if I can handle it all!
With ten more minutes until curtain, $ZOE heads backstage again...
When she hears Kimi's voice.
She turns and sees Kimi and her family in the front.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: So when are you going on again?

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: Mom, relax! She'll be on when she's on!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, Mom. It'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Are you sure this is going to happen? Your name's not even in the program.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm kind of a last minute addition, so my name was never going to be printed. It's okay. I'd rather it be that way instead.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: But are you `sure` that you're going on?
nodes.text_bbcode: But are you [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] that you're going on?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Kimi, for your sake, I don't want this to be another embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Poor Kimi... I don't want her to look bad in front of her mother... And it sounds like she really needs to perform...
$ZOE does some calculations in her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There is exactly five extra minutes built into the show for the second act... If `nothing` goes wrong after the intermission, Kimi will have time to sing...
nodes.text_bbcode: There is exactly five extra minutes built into the show for the second act... If [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing[/i][/color] goes wrong after the intermission, Kimi will have time to sing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But when have things ever gone perfectly?
$ZOE steps in front of Kimi's family.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, Mrs. Chen, Kimi is for sure going on. I was just coming to grab her right now.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...You were? Er, I mean... Oh there you are!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're just happy she asked to perform.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Kimi, you had to `ask` to be in the show?
nodes.text_bbcode: Kimi, you had to [color=#3b78e2][i]ask[/i][/color] to be in the show?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, actually. It's funny. We were debating whether or not to let Kimi on because she's so...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Yes, I know that already. You told me on the phone.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: That's why I'm here, right? To see exactly how un-slackerish you are?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it is.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Don't worry, $ZOE. I haven't forgotten you!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: But we'll just have to see how the rest of this night goes, won't we?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You like hair, I like hair. And I still like the cheerleading team, even if I'm not on it.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Ha ha, $ZOE. You're so funny! I like that.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh good!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I haven't forgotten you!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: But I do have to do what's best for Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: We'll just have to see how the rest of this night goes, won't we?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I'm not sure I understand what your definition of 'talent' is.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: The performances I saw were dismal!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: The hot dog eater was completely uncool!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: And I wasn't sure if the juggling was totally serious or slapstick or something else! It was not well-explained at all.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's kind of a `funny` Talent Show, you know?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's kind of a [color=#3b78e2][i]funny[/i][/color] Talent Show, you know?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: No, I don't!
Like in practice, at first everything starts out okay!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go long!
Hector tosses her a long ball.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Go where?
And Amanda catches it!
But the minute more objects start coming at Amanda, the worse it gets!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go high!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't be silly, Hector! I can't fl--
A colorful juggling ball smacks Amanda in the face!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow, ball, ow!
It happens with the juggling bats...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow, bat, ow!
And with the rings!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow, rings, ow!
With all their props strewn on stage, Dex steps into halt the madness.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And a big round of applause for that `horrible` display of talent!
nodes.text_bbcode: And a big round of applause for that [color=#e23b3b][i]horrible[/i][/color] display of talent!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow, Dex, ow!
Hector helps Amanda offstage.
$ZOE sweeps aside the curtain to let Hector and Amanda back into the wings. Missy is checking her phone and looks bored.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, good work, guys...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Were you watching? Amanda's seriously hurt.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What did you say? I'm 'seriously a purse'?
Hector herds her towards the dressing room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope Missy didn't think that was awful...
Spencer walks onstage uncertainly. He sits down at a table with a vast hot dog spread over it.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: All right, Spencer. How many hot dogs can you eat in one minute?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh...
He stares blankly out at the audience then at Dex.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, your personal record is fifteen, so, uh, maybe we'll do that again?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Let's see you eat them! Get ready... Get `neat`... Go eat!
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's see you eat them! Get ready... Get [color=#e23b3b][i]neat[/i][/color]... Go eat!

nodes.text: Spencer tries to swallow the first hot dog...
And starts sputtering and coughing!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh...
Sam leaps out from backstage and starts slapping Spencer on the back! He coughs and the hotdog launches through the air like a meaty javelin and splats down into the first row.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: `Ewww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ewww![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry!
Sadly, Sam leads him offstage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to bring him back to the dressing room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good idea.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guess my stomach knots are worse than I thought!
He trudges back to the dressing room with Sam as Hector and Amanda rush past him!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Guess the amazing eater has had enough for one day!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's just... Performing tonight would really mean a lot to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, `maybe` there's `some` time if we--
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]maybe[/i][/color] there's [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] time if we--

nodes.text: $ZOE spots Taylor giving her a hard look from the other side of the room, and she shuts her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't really promise you anything, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay... I understand. But if there's even a chance you can get me in, let me know! I'll be in the audience! I can go on at any time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will!
Kimi runs off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! Showtime in one minute!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, Dex! Let's get ourselves out there!
A minute later, Dex walks center stage, holding a mic.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Twin Branches Talent Show! The mystifying, the dazzling, the just plain confusing... You'll find it all here!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Now, for our first act, I'd like to introduce Spencer the Spectacular Eater!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We only have the auditorium reserved for so much time, and then the school needs to start setting up graduation stuff.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't cut other performers' acts short to add one in at the last minute.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know... I figured. I was... Just hoping.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, it's an important show to me too!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's my second chance to prove myself!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If there's even just, like `five` minutes that I could take up...
nodes.text_bbcode: If there's even just, like [color=#3b78e2][i]five[/i][/color] minutes that I could take up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, it's not like $ZOE can magically make time go slower. The Talent Show has to be done by eight o'clock sharp tonight.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We've planned around that. Adding in another performer's not going to help.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't realize... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, five minutes and counting to curtain up, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam. Let's head back to the stage.
Suddenly, there's commotion near the door. She looks over and spots Dex and Kimi enter.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Come on, she's this way. Remember what you promised me for doing this for you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Obviously! I'll help you write out a letter after the show.
Dex and Kimi walk into the room. Around them, people start whispering.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's `her`... Did you `see` her TV performance?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color]... Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]see[/i][/color] her TV performance?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I did. Can we say 'totally embarrassing'?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What a sad tale!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Yeah! Poor Kimi! I'd hate to be in her place.
Kimi, for the most part, ignores the others and lets Dex lead her straight to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Dex! Aren't you supposed to be backstage? You're the emcee for the show!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I remembered! But I have a favor to ask of you.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I know the programs have already been printed and passed out, but I want to squeeze one more act into the show.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have an act that you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ha ha, but no, it's not for me. It's for Kimi here. She wants to sing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She does? Why?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sure you've heard how... Terrible my performance on TV went. I want a second chance to try singing. Here and now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if that'd be a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because I was totally awkward?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, how you did on TV doesn't have anything to do with this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi, normally, I'd `love` to put you into the program, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Kimi, normally, I'd [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to put you into the program, but...

nodes.prompt: I'd love to put you into the program, but...

options.label: It wouldn't be fair to other performers.
The show's too important to me.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I'd love to put you into the program, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If it's something you hate, you'll probably be able to think about it, but not focus on it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aww, do I have to?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll see if it works. Try counting or adding doubles or something.
Amanda screws up her nose and tries to double numbers in her head.
Hector throws a baton at her, and Amanda catches it behind her back!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Three!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awesome. We're going to be the best math-doing jugglers ever!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I look forward to seeing that!
Hector herds Amanda away.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: If it's an odd number, can it even be doubled?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If it's something she loves, she'll be distracted enough that she can juggle!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I did already try shoes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Amanda `loves` purses, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: But Amanda [color=#3b78e2][i]loves[/i][/color] purses, right?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh, yeah! They're like my life line. My wonderful leather life line.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we can try it.
Amanda closes her eyes, smiles, and thinks about leather purses of every shape, color, and type.
Hector throws a baton at her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Watch out!
The baton bounces off Amanda to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, Amanda, I hit you! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mmm, leather, suede, teal, aubergine, straps...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda?
She doesn't respond.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops. Maybe we found something she loves a little `too` much.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoops. Maybe we found something she loves a little [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] much.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll take care of this. We don't have any pickles around, do we? The smell will bring her back to us...
Hector leads Amanda away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was weird, right? You thought so too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know what to think.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE!
Hector runs up to her and clutches her arm.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You have to come over here. Amanda's forgotten how to juggle!
Hector drags $ZOE and Sam through the crowd to where Amanda is sitting, focusing intently at her fancy costumed dress with bright gold threads.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, this dress... It's just so shiny!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See? See what she's doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sitting?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, she's focusing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's unusual, but I don't think it's anything to worry about.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's where you're wrong. We're jugglers, $ZOE. Jugglers don't concentrate.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, really? Aren't you tossing balls and bats and other dangerous items at each other?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, `yes,` but when you're as awesomely skilled as we are, there's a certain element of `non-focus` that allows you to do all those things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]yes,[/i][/color] but when you're as awesomely skilled as we are, there's a certain element of [color=#e23b3b][i]non-focus[/i][/color] that allows you to do all those things.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda and I don't think instinctively!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, you just came out and said that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Here, I'll show you what I mean. Hey, Amanda, let's practice our routine real quick.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee!
They step a couple feet away from each other and start juggling. At first everything is fine. Amanda catches the ball and tosses it back to Hector.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's like playing catch with an octopus!
But then things start to go wrong. Hector adds two more balls to their routine and throws them at Amanda. She fumbles for the first and misses! The second one hits her in the shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! Missing hurts!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See what I mean? You saw our rehearsals. She normally has it down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't know! It used to be really easy, but then I got a gold sparkly outfit, and now juggling just makes my head hurt!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She thinks too much when she sees glitter. I don't know why I didn't think of it before!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You have to help me `un`focus her. If she thinks about it too much, it'll get worse.
nodes.text_bbcode: You have to help me [color=#e23b3b][i]un[/i][/color]focus her. If she thinks about it too much, it'll get worse.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You just have to help me think of something she can think about but won't fixate on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That is a weird request, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just try it. I've already gone through all the adorable animals that she loves.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Puppies are just too distracting!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Try thinking about...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes admitting a problem is the first step!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? You're crazy! I'm not nervous!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But your stomach's knotting up right before the show. And I bet your palms are sweaty.
Spencer wipes his hands on his jeans.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the exact opposite of what I want him to do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Spencer, it's okay. Everyone gets nervous sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now, look, if you're not going to help me, I got a hot dog eating gig to get ready for.
He grabs his cooler of hot dogs and sits down stubbornly, facing a corner. He rubs his stomach, and $ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Spencer's as stubborn as a mule.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are those stubborn?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Supposedly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope he'll be okay when the show starts.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That shouldn't be too hard for you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When `aren't` you thinking about football?
nodes.text_bbcode: When [color=#3b78e2][i]aren't[/i][/color] you thinking about football?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... But how's that supposed to help me out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you get nerv--Er, well, does your stomach hurt when you play football?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No. Because I'm playing football. The sport I `love.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No. Because I'm playing football. The sport I [color=#e23b3b][i]love.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what I thought. Sometimes thinking about a time when your, uh, stomach doesn't hurt will make it not hurt now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I kind of get it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! So concentrate on how you feel during football, and then you'll feel the same way now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's a lot of feeling...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But, hey, my stomach's doing pretty okay.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excellent.
$ZOE walks away, dusting her hands off.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thirty-two, twenty-four, hut, hut, hot dog!
She ducks into the dressing room...
...Where everything is surprisingly normal.
Performers warm up their acts. Brendan checks the laces on his shoes, Erik tries to decide between hula hoops, and Andrew does breathing exercises.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh. I wonder what Taylor was talking about.
And that's when she sees Ben and Owen talking to Spencer in the corner.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't do this. I can't go on stage and eat hot dogs in front of strangers!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure you can. You did for Romeo and Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Well, not the hot dog part, but you know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't be stupid, man. I had a sword for Romeo and Juliet.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Does that make a difference?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are meat pizzas the best in the world?
Spencer clutches his stomach.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nnnhhh... I shouldn't have mentioned meat pizza. I can't go out on stage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay that you're nervous, Spencer. It's normal.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nervous? I'm not `nervous!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nervous? I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]nervous![/i][/color]

nodes.text: My stomach is feeling bad, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like it's in knots?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, yeah! How'd you know?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because that's typically what happens with stage fright.

nodes.text: I'm not `afraid!`

nodes.text: $ZOE steps over.

nodes.speaker: Ben

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is anything wrong over here?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My stomach's in knots. And `not` because I'm a wuss or anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: My stomach's in knots. And [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] because I'm a wuss or anything.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't go on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Spencer, you `have` to. The audience needs to see how many hot dogs you can eat in one minute!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, Spencer, you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to. The audience needs to see how many hot dogs you can eat in one minute!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not to mention how a last minute cancellation would look to Missy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The most important thing to do is...
$ZOE sprints face-first into the door, slamming her nose into it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow! My nose!
She reaches up to rub it with one hand while she sheepishly opens the door with the other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope I didn't hurt it too badly!
Behind her, Sam stifles a laugh.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha, are, hee, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not funny, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You ran face first into a door... It's, heh, funny as long as you're okay!
$ZOE ignores her and runs through the door.
$ZOE pushes the handle down and out, barely breaking stride! She bursts through the door, tearing down a corridor!
Sam runs in behind her.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Almost there!
$ZOE sticks her hand out for the door handle and misses!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You feeling better, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A little. But you have no idea how high-strung everyone else is right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You haven't seen your performers? Everyone's a wreck!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tensions are high, and everyone's going crazy back there. You should probably check on them... Unless you want the rehearsal to happen all over again.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I have to remind you how long it took to get the scorch marks and glitter off the theater floor?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nope! I'm on it!
$ZOE groans and runs towards the dressing room, all the awful possibilites of what could be going on there running through her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just please tell me that it doesn't involve `fire...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just please tell me that it doesn't involve [color=#3b78e2][i]fire...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: With Sam on her heels, $ZOE runs straight for the closed door leading backstage. She reaches down and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They say that just the act of smiling makes you feel so much better!
Taylor growls at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Does it `look` like putting a `smile` on is possible right now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Does it [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] like putting a [color=#3b78e2][i]smile[/i][/color] on is possible right now?

nodes.text: Uh, er, you `are` really angry.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, er, you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] really angry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I seriously think it would hurt your face.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No one's asking you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're no help at all.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, forget this! I wish I could just dump it all on Justin!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Now `there's` an idea. Good job, self.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Now [color=#3b78e2][i]there's[/i][/color] an idea. Good job, self.

nodes.text: Taylor pats herself on the back.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No thanks to you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, let's not put `more` pressure on $ZOE than there is already.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, let's not put [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] pressure on $ZOE than there is already.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every time I think you're human, you say something really crazy and perky, and then I know that you're not.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 'Helping hands'? What are we, six years old?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What I'm saying is that any big task becomes more doable when you have people helping you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't that what you have Justin for?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Hm, I already ask him to do a lot. But I suppose I wouldn't mind asking him to do `more.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Hm, I already ask him to do a lot. But I suppose I wouldn't mind asking him to do [color=#3b78e2][i]more.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what Vice Presidents are for!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Using Justin isn't the `worst` idea I've heard.
nodes.text_bbcode: Using Justin isn't the [color=#3b78e2][i]worst[/i][/color] idea I've heard.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Note to self. Get Justin to do more.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik, hula hooping is perfectly noble. I don't know where you got the idea that people are laughing at the way you hula hoop. Erik, hula hooping is perfectly noble.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Noble?
$ZOE glares at her cousin.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It might have been when Hannah pointed at me, laughed, and said, 'You look funny when you hula hoop, nerd!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't let that discourage you, Erik. I love the way you hula hoop.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one does it better. It's a great skill, and you do it so well that it has to be your true calling!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if you want people to laugh with you, a Talent Show is the `best` place to do it! What do you say?
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you want people to laugh with you, a Talent Show is the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] place to do it! What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I guess if you put it that way... I have to go on and do what I do best!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the spirit!
Erik walks onstage after Dex's announcement.

nodes.text: Good evening, boys and girls! It's me, Erik Ericson! And I'm going to show you hula hooping so extreme, it'll knock your socks straight off!
Erik demonstrates his hula-hooping prowess as Sam and $ZOE look on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good work with him back there. Nothing I was saying was working.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad what `I` said worked.

nodes.text: And without $ZOE, Kimi never would've gotten the opportunity to perform, something she really needed.

nodes.text: $ZOE has always looked out for the student body of this school... Which is exactly why she's just consented to giving the speech at graduation.

nodes.text: I did?
Taylor elbows $ZOE `hard` in the ribs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erp! I mean, yes! I did just accept the speech!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Why $ZOE, you never told me that you're giving the commencement address! That's such an important honor.

nodes.text: `I` gave a commencement address at my old school.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] gave a commencement address at my old school.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: And your friend is right. Maybe I thought way too hard about how much you weren't following the program, and didn't think that much about what you put in!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Well, I think I've made my decision...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE, even though you aren't a cheerleader, you've shown me a lot. I'm proud to say...

nodes.text: Welcome to Kingston!

nodes.text: Ladies and gentleman, this is not part of the scheduled program, but we have a surprise for you!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And now, for our final act, I'm proud to announce a special performance from local celebrity and singing sensation, Kimi Chen!
Kimi steps out on stage. Several people hoot and call out to her, and Kimi falters for a second.
But then she collects herself, takes the mic from Dex, and clears her throat. Her sister starts playing the piano, and Kimi starts singing clearly and beautifully.
In the wings, $ZOE and Sam grin at one another.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We did it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, we did.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know I told you this wasn't a good idea, but seeing it now... I'm glad it happened.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope Missy thinks the same!
After Kimi's performance, $ZOE supervises the audience's vote and presides over the announcement of the winner!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...And first place goes to... Amir Singh! For Magic Is Believing!
And a short time afterwards, $ZOE finds Missy in the middle of the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, what'd you think?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: The right person won. I absolutely `loved` the magic show.
nodes.text_bbcode: The right person won. I absolutely [color=#3b78e2][i]loved[/i][/color] the magic show.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: It was fun, but it was really crazy chaotic! That Kimi girl at the end wasn't even in the program! She could sing, but I found the shock of it very jarring!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, well, she's kind of a local celebrity. It felt right to fit her in.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Local celebrity or not, she wasn't scheduled!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I thought you were an amazing planner! Wasn't this supposed to be your perfect show?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: It was kinda disappointing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, uh, sometimes things you don't expect come up...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excuse me, but I couldn't help but overhear. Running a perfect Talent Show isn't just about getting every act printed in the programs. It's about making sure that everyone is taken care of.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: None.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE, but if we don't get voting done to pick a winner, it's just not going to happen at all.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But maybe we can rush the voting?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you want... But I'm telling you that we're out of time.
Kimi runs up to $ZOE and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm ready for my debut!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Listen, Kimi, we don't have time to put you on.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But you don't understand! I `have` to go on! This is my second chance!
nodes.text_bbcode: But you don't understand! I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to go on! This is my second chance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I know, but you see, the timing isn't--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm going on!
Kimi clutches her microphone and starts sprinting towards the stage! $ZOE sprints after her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, wait! You can't go out there! This is `my` second chance too!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, wait! You can't go out there! This is [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] second chance too!

nodes.text: $ZOE gains on Kimi. She leaps, intending to take Kimi down...
She hits Kimi in full force, and they fly onto the stage!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Stop it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, `you` stop it!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] stop it!

nodes.text: The tackle surprises and horrifies the audience!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What is this?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh my!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Aw, yeah!
Back on stage... Kimi and $ZOE wrestle for the microphone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You. `Can't.` Sing!
nodes.text_bbcode: You. [color=#3b78e2][i]Can't.[/i][/color] Sing!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I. `Can.` Too!
nodes.text_bbcode: I. [color=#3b78e2][i]Can.[/i][/color] Too!

nodes.text: And that's when the theater is plunged into darkness!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, hello?

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: Kimi?!
The audience and performers panic!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Looks like somebody couldn't afford to pay the electric bill... `Typical.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like somebody couldn't afford to pay the electric bill... [color=#3b78e2][i]Typical.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Where am I? What's happened?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My eyes! My eyes! I can't see!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why did the lights go off?
In the darkness, $ZOE feels someone grab her and haul her to her feet!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhh!
She bats at the person holding her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, it's me, stupid! The lights are off because the prep team wants to do something with the stage lights, so they shut the power down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When's it going back on?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know! But I `told` you not to go off schedule, and you decided to wrestle Kimi when the audience was supposed to be voting! What were you thinking?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know! But I [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] you not to go off schedule, and you decided to wrestle Kimi when the audience was supposed to be voting! What were you thinking?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was `trying` to `stop` her!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]trying[/i][/color] to [color=#3b78e2][i]stop[/i][/color] her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, now you've ruined it for everyone! This is a mess! And now `I` have to fix it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, now you've ruined it for everyone! This is a mess! And now [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] have to fix it!

nodes.text: $ZOE can feel Taylor leave her in the darkness. She stumbles around, trying to look for a way out.
In the chaos of people leaving, $ZOE can hear Missy's voice.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE, but this is a mess! Wrestling on stage is not how Kingston people act! If you can hear me, I'm leaving!
And $ZOE knows in her heart...
She has failed.

nodes.text: The monologue will make me really happy.

Erik throws his hula hoop to the ground and digs around in his bag.

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik, be quick!
Erik fumbles around with his robe and wig. $ZOE hovers around nervously while he finishes up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, people are waiting...

nodes.text: I'm almost there! I'm almost there!
Erik stumbles onstage a couple minutes late.

nodes.text: Good evening, citizens of earth! My name is Captain Quark, and I have some theories to share with you on quantum physics, time and space, and love and life...
Erik continues his monologue as $ZOE and Sam watch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe I blew that. I should have just told him that hula hooping was amazing. Now he's late, doing a speech I don't know that `he` knows...

nodes.text: Don't beat yourself up too much...
...And shoves it in Hannah's hands!

nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.text: What about the cane?
$ZOE turns and spots a single crutch and a plunger. She grabs the...

nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Daughter to Charlemain, who was the son to Lewis the emperor... And Lewis the son of Charles the Great...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Right?!
After another refrain, $ZOE pushes the button!
$ZOE is wracked with indecision!
Uncertain if it's the right moment, $ZOE doesn't push the button, and Andrew drones on.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Then hear me, gracious sovereign, and you peers...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Then hear me, gracious sovereign, and you peers...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `That owe yourselves, your lives and services...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That owe yourselves, your lives and services...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: And another minute passes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No need to push the button yet!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `I speak not to disprove what Brutus spoke, but here I am to speak what I do know...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I speak not to disprove what Brutus spoke, but here I am to speak what I do know...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Another minute passes by...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To reiterate the schedule... It's Colt's pickpocketing routine, followed by Andrew's Shakespearean monologue, Ashley and Hannah's 1920s dance number, and Erik's extreme hula hooping. Kimi goes on after.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Andrew, your monologue's only two minutes long, so don't go over.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Do I ever?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. `Twice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes. [color=#3b78e2][i]Twice.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I can't help if it I'm so passionate that I simply `must` speak the next portion!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't help if it I'm so passionate that I simply [color=#e23b3b][i]must[/i][/color] speak the next portion!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm ready! Denni, Ashley, and Hannah have agreed to be pick-pocketed for my act.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ashley and Hannah, since you're volunteers for Colt's act `and` doing your own dance at the end, you have to make sure your costume change is really quick. You'll have time during Andrew's speech to change backstage.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ashley and Hannah, since you're volunteers for Colt's act [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] doing your own dance at the end, you have to make sure your costume change is really quick. You'll have time during Andrew's speech to change backstage.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Yep! My outfit and props are in the dressing room and ready to go!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And my stuff's in my bag!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik, what about you? Do you have everything you need?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fantastical gold cape, check. Lucky green hula hoop, check. Myself, of course, check!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then we're on in two minutes! Colt and the pickpocket crew, get to your places! I'll meet you backstage!
The second act begins!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And we're back! First up in the second half of this Talent Show is Colt the Proficient Pickpocket!
On cue, Colt and his three assistants step onstage.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Some say this is a lost art... I'm here today to prove that it's still alive and kickin'!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: These three lovely ladies here have agreed to let me pick their pockets. Ladies, if you'll empty your pockets out to show the audience what you've got...
From the wings, $ZOE and Sam watch Colt's act play out. $ZOE checks and double checks her schedule sheet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So far so good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you think you can buy enough time for Kimi to go on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She only needs five minutes, and there's five minutes built into the schedule for mistakes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And right now, we're on track!
Applause rings out from the audience as Colt wraps up his act.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, if that act didn't `pick-pocket` our hearts, I don't know what will! Let's give it up for Colt the Pickpocket!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if that act didn't [color=#e23b3b][i]pick-pocket[/i][/color] our hearts, I don't know what will! Let's give it up for Colt the Pickpocket!

nodes.text: The audience laughs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Andrew, front and center! You're on in thirty seconds!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I've been waiting for this moment my entire life!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right there, drama queen. Remember not to go over two minutes.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I don't see why my art should be so restricted. `Three` minutes would make my performance better. A monologue is one of the most powerful tools in an actor's handbook. Like I said before, I can't help it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't see why my art should be so restricted. [color=#e23b3b][i]Three[/i][/color] minutes would make my performance better. A monologue is one of the most powerful tools in an actor's handbook. Like I said before, I can't help it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh. We'll give you a thirty-second warning.
Andrew shrugs as Colt and his volunteers exit the stage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ashley and Hannah, your dresses are on the clothes rack over there.
$ZOE gestures to a rack a few feet away.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: We'll get changed right away!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, one of us should check on Erik to see if he needs anything. Do you want to do that, or should I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd like to stay here if you don't mind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's fine with me. You're on Andrew duty then. Tap on the green button when you want him to stop talking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah... I'll make sure he doesn't go over.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And now... Here's Andrew, acting as Antony from Shakespeare's 'Julius Caesar'!
Andrew walks solemnly onstage, his brow furrowed, his demeanor brooding.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears... I come to bury Caesar, not to praise him.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears... I come to bury Caesar, not to praise him.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE stands next to a button that triggers a green light visible only to the people onstage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, I need to push the button when he's almost done...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now was that three minutes or two minutes?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Here, under leave of Brutus and the rest... For Brutus is an honorable man...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Here, under leave of Brutus and the rest... For Brutus is an honorable man...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The first minute passes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I saw it. So what? Whatever she did on live TV, it has nothing to do with what we're doing now, does it?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Does it?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Does it?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hannah shuts her mouth and purses her lips.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I guess not!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great. I don't want to hear anything else about it. We are going to talk about the schedule.
The door swings open, and Kimi walks in wearing a pretty white dress.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, what'd I miss?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm briefing everyone. You're just in time. We're doing a quick rundown of the second half.
$ZOE doesn't interrupt Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, I saw what she did. It was hard to watch!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It wasn't so bad...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yeah, it was! Awful! Horrendous! If I were her, I wouldn't perform ever again.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Actually... If you put her before all of our acts, we'd all look better.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Heh... That's not a bad idea!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That's mean, you guys.
Ashley looks to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should have stopped this earlier...
The door swings open, and Kimi walks in wearing a flowing white dress.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, guys, what'd I miss?
$ZOE clears her throat and glares at everyone else in the room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing. I'm just briefing everyone. Let's start with a quick rundown of the second half.
In the dressing room, $ZOE organizes the performers for the second act.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, guys. Listen up! The rest of the Talent Show is going to start in five minutes! I need everyone to hit their cues exactly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because if everything goes according to plan, then Kimi will be able to sing her number at the end!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You're letting Kimi sing in front of everyone?
$ZOE looks around nervously for Kimi, but she's still in the bathroom changing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, I am.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You're putting that train wreck on stage after all of us go?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, did you `see` her live TV performance?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, did you [color=#3b78e2][i]see[/i][/color] her live TV performance?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Moving onwards... Introducing the magnificent duo, Hector and Amanda... The Juggling Jokers!
Hector and Amanda step onstage, bow to the audience, and position themselves for their act.
But there's no more time for $ZOE to worry about Hector and Amanda. The acts just keep going!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And next up! Amir Singh with 'Magic is Believin'!
At intermission, $ZOE walks out from the wings to view the audience.
Many people have come. She recognizes some familiar faces...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Isn't it wonderful to be here, Horace? We're supporting the school Howard grew up in!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I thought the point of him graduating was so we `didn't` have to support the school anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought the point of him graduating was so we [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't[/i][/color] have to support the school anymore.

nodes.text: She spots some faraway faces...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe I came here willingly. What kind of talent is this? These are all carnival tricks! Where's the money, the death-defying acts, the drama?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Isn't your boyfriend or whatever performing?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, this is just the kind of cheap show he'd `love` to participate in.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, this is just the kind of cheap show he'd [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to participate in.

nodes.text: And just a few rows from the front, $ZOE sees Missy.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Hello, hi, $ZOE! It is `fabulous` to see you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello, hi, $ZOE! It is [color=#3b78e2][i]fabulous[/i][/color] to see you!

nodes.text: Missy hugs $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you enjoying the Talent Show so far?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, there's a much, much better second set coming up after the intermission that I'm sure you'll enjoy!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Oh, I will? That sounds super amazing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how's the interviewing of candidates going?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: It's totally great! You know what? I found another cheerleader who's equally qualified!
$ZOE feels her stomach tighten.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Great! Really.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I'm `so` ecstatic to take her on.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] ecstatic to take her on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're accepting her?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: It's not decided...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: But I really, really want to! She and I could be the best of friends!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Unfortunately, there are `guidelines` for the people we accept. Kingston's not for slackers as you know.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unfortunately, there are [color=#3b78e2][i]guidelines[/i][/color] for the people we accept. Kingston's not for slackers as you know.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Since I can only accept one more student this round, I can't just choose someone willy-nilly!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: But you know me! I'm always looking for recruits to the cheerleading team, so she's on the top of my list.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, just listen to me prattle on, would you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She can only accept one more student? Yikes! This is going to be tough!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should remind her why I'm a good candidate for Kingston in case she forgot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I still hope you'll consider me in the running because...

nodes.prompt: I still hope you'll consider me because...

options.label: We could be good friends too!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I still hope you'll consider me because...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How are we doing on time? Can we fit Kimi in after?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really want to know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! Something's up with Erik! He doesn't want to go on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've been thinking. Even though I'm good at it, this hula-hooping thing may not be the thing for me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I overheard other people laughing `at` me, not `with` me. I don't think the world is ready for what I can do. So I have to tell you that I can't go on like I promised.
nodes.text_bbcode: I overheard other people laughing [color=#e23b3b][i]at[/i][/color] me, not [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] me. I don't think the world is ready for what I can do. So I have to tell you that I can't go on like I promised.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? You're giving up hula hooping because other people might make fun of you? But not, say, Paul Revere trivia?
$ZOE ignores her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik, I'd really like you to stay on and perform.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, of course I don't want to bring you down! So I thought of something I `could` do that `isn't` hula-hooping.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, of course I don't want to bring you down! So I thought of something I [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color] do that [color=#e23b3b][i]isn't[/i][/color] hula-hooping.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Something not on the program?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can do a monologue, just like Andrew! Except instead of Shakespeare, I do a scene from my favorite TV show Space 'Splosions!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There's this famous monologue Captain Quark does on the show about the importance of moving forward through life, space, and time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if it's a good idea to let Erik go on with something he hasn't practiced...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But how can I convince him that hula hooping is better than talking about space ships?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, Dex is just about to announce Erik!
$ZOE turns to Erik desperately.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik, I'm sure the monologue is great, but you should still hula hoop. Hula hooping is...
Andrew glances at the light...
And winds his speech down.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `My heart is in the coffin there with Caesar, and I must pause till it come back to me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]My heart is in the coffin there with Caesar, and I must pause till it come back to me.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He ends with a bow of his head, and the audience claps with enthusiasm.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Thank you, thank you!
Andrew steps off.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great work, Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Of course it was exemplary.
He walks off as Ashley runs up to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `And rather choose to hide them in a net than amply to imbar their crooked titles...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And rather choose to hide them in a net than amply to imbar their crooked titles...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Andrew takes an extra minute to finish his monologue and get offstage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Andrew! What was that? You went way over time!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You didn't signal soon enough! I had to finish out the monologue I'd already started!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or you could have just `stopped` at the place we'd agreed on.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or you could have just [color=#3b78e2][i]stopped[/i][/color] at the place we'd agreed on.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I. Am. An. Actor! I answer to no one! It's too late now, anyhow! What's done is done, and you can do nothing to stop me!
$ZOE opens her mouth to talk back, but is interrupted by Ashley!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: $ZOE! Problem!
$ZOE lets Ashley drag her to where Hannah is digging into her bag.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: $ZOE! The bag I packed doesn't have the top hat and cane that I need!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What do we do? Dex is already starting to announce us!
$ZOE scans the prop racks near the stage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can replace your top hat with...
In the dressing room, $ZOE organizes the performers for the second act.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, guys. Listen up! The rest of the Talent Show is going to start in five minutes! I need everyone to hit their cues exactly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because if everything goes according to plan, then Kimi will be able to sing her number at the end!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You're letting Kimi sing in front of everyone?
$ZOE looks around nervously for Kimi, but she's still in the bathroom changing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, I am.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You're putting that train wreck on stage after all of us go?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, did you `see` her live TV performance?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: All right, Spencer. How many hot dogs can you eat in one minute?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Let's see it then! On my mark! Get ready... Get `neat`... Go eat!

nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.text: Taylor? What are you doing here? You should be in the dressing room, getting ready for your first act!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I'm `here` now. I wanted to talk with you about tonight's schedule.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color] now. I wanted to talk with you about tonight's schedule.

nodes.text: I know. You told me last week. The show will end by eight exactly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. But what's with the packed lineup in the second act? I saw in the program that Andrew is acting.

nodes.text: You do realize that if you keep the curtain open `too` long, then Andrew's just going to keep going into another monologue, right?

nodes.text: And what about the costume change for Hannah and Ashley? They're volunteering for Colt's show, so they only have one act to get dressed for theirs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll have their costumes available backstage for changing. I remember, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'd better.

nodes.text: Whoa, Taylor. What's up with you? What do you care anyway? $ZOE's running the show here.

nodes.text: It's my show too. The funds we get from this are going to be the difference between graduation galore and graduation ga-`bore!`

nodes.text: Well, we've already made some money by selling tickets.

nodes.text: And we're making the rest up in concessions! If people think the show is boring, then they'll `leave.` If they leave, they `won't` buy snacks. If they don't buy snacks, we will have `no money!`

nodes.text: That means no mixups, mashups, or... Or mistake-ups!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you okay? You're turning red.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. Relax. Take a deep breath.

nodes.text: Ugh, you're right. This is just... Getting to me. I'm helping the administration with all the graduation festivities...

nodes.text: Pulling together the funds, planning the senior school trip, figuring out the program... I haven't even selected the best student to speak for the graduation ceremony!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or I'm going to die trying!
